'''Tyler Herman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Parker tournament]] on 21 October 2000 with Jabba's Palace, according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1371">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-22-parker-co-10-21-00-total-carnaged1371/ parker-co-10-21-00-total-carnage], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 22 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-22-parker-co-10-21-00-total-carnaged1371/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
